name: Saint Cyril of Alexandria
biography: Patriarch of Alexandria and 'advocate of unity' of Christ's nature against Nestorius; described by Russell, quoting Gibbon, as a fanatic who incited pogroms against Alexandria's Jews and whose followers lynched the Neoplatonist philosopher Hypatia; presided, by force of arrival first, over the Council of Ephesus (431) that condemned Nestorius.
